rule: After nominal confirmation accepts, reject if maximum positive delta over separately constructed compatible witnesses exceeds120 seconds; incomplete risk checks fall back to B.
reason: One fixed engineering threshold of two virtual minutes (600m travel equivalent), not a tuned optimum. Test a concrete bounded veto increment while reporting nominal gain and regret tails separately.
evidence_before_registration: 60 G12 offline replays with38 risk decisions

evidence_summary.warning: Risk loss is not an estimate of actual loss. Veto may sacrifice real gains; no safety/performance guarantee.

execution: Run G3 and the fixed G3V increment on the same complete development set, at most two CPU processes; no source edits to running jobs.
